# occurrence is positioned at itself (a read) or at its write construct (a write); the chain of kinds from the node's statement
# root down to that position must be all `seq` for the position to take part in an order proof.
# seq = children evaluated left to right in source order, a write construct performs its write at its end byte |
# loop = a repeated context: no order proof through it | unknown = any comparison involving a position under it is unproven (refuse) |
# deferred = a region (runs later; never proves) | none = no runtime evaluation | leaf = no children.
